verdict: FIX-FIRST: the diagnosis is correct for Prepare/Snapshot, but its shared-key migration stops short of several saveable page results.
blockers: One canonical identity snapshot is required across the 21 useActiveTab call sites: today each hook instance owns its own query/listeners (src/hooks/use-active-tab.ts:9-45). A per-hook getFrame retrofit can let parent/child consumers disagree about document during a reload. Keep tab id/url/title available for Tasks, Vault, and URL lookup while exposing a separate resolved/unresolved top-frame document identity for page results; do not install a second resolver in consumers.

The migration census must include DataView manual rows and auto store (src/features/data/DataView.tsx:44-73,215-280; src/state/auto-extract.ts:8-63), useAutoExtract's TTL and late run admission (src/hooks/use-auto-extract.ts:41-103), and Showcase Recipes, Framework sources, Patterns runs, ListPattern config/probes, and Doctor recommendations (their tab-id/URL keys under src/features/showcase/tabs). All can retain or re-admit A on same-URL document B; Snapshot-only acceptance is insufficient.

useExtraction resets rows but leaves detection and its auto-detect eligibility keyed to tab id/URL (src/hooks/use-extraction.ts:47-85,122-149). The new document must clear old detection immediately and re-detect B; the completed-row, late-success, and late-error guards must use the same shared snapshot. useAiExtraction stream and usePatternFromData results are further page-derived consumers (src/hooks/use-ai-extraction.ts:47-108,120-205; src/hooks/use-pattern-from-data.ts:132-276).

Network capture checks event.tab_id only and keeps events/installed/source when a same-tab document changes (src/hooks/use-network-capture.ts:30-100,149-183). The shared identity transition must stop/clear ordinary capture and reject late events; document-network replay has its own approved-document contract, so preserve that session-specific protection rather than replacing it with a URL key.

A loading event is not a replacement document. On top-frame navigation start, withhold A's page-derived output; on commit/recheck resolve Chrome's documentId and URL, and if navigation aborts restore only after re-reading the still-current A. Sequence query and getFrame together; reject an older refresh after a newer activation/commit. Unresolved identity must have an explicit retry/remedy on page-result actions, never a silent disabled button or fabricated null-equals-null key (src/hooks/use-active-tab.ts:13-45; wxt.config.ts:45,66-80 already has Chrome 116 and webNavigation).
acceptance: Automated A/B same-tab same-URL reload proves immediate withholding, current B capture, rejection of A late success/error, no A auto-store/save/diagnostic/network residue, title/subframe churn stability, SPA URL invalidation, canceled navigation recovery, out-of-order refresh safety, inactive-tab activation, and unresolved getFrame remedy. Native acceptance uses the built extension on a real public HTTPS page with an actual Chrome Reload and page fields as oracle; controlled fixtures count only as regression evidence.
scope_boundary: URL/domain persisted lookups (page recognition, pattern catalog, SEO history, highlights) can remain URL-scoped; page-derived live results within those surfaces need document-bound admission. No localhost native acceptance.
